# Sift agent context

Sift is one Rust SRE product for logs, metrics, and traces. Read README.md
before changing its public contract. Read HA.md before changing replication,
Kubernetes, backup, or recovery behavior.

## Product boundary

- Public ingest is OTLP logs, metrics, and traces plus Prometheus Remote Write 1.0.
- Public query uses `/api/v1/*` and `/prometheus/api/v1/*`.
- MCP is read-only in phase one.
- Profiles, audit, evaluation, and generic event APIs are outside phase one.
- Sift owns its signal storage. Do not add Loki, Mimir, Tempo, ClickHouse, or another database.

## Data safety

- The default root is `/var/lib/sift`.
- The order is `--data-dir`, `SIFT_DATA_DIR`, then `/var/lib/sift`.
- Never fall back to the current directory or `/tmp`.
- Never open one data root from two processes.
- Treat `sift backup --data-dir` and every restore as a stopped-process operation.
- Do not modify a Sift 0.1.1 legacy root. Automatic migration is not supported.
- Use `--ephemeral` only for an explicit local `all` process.

## Commands

- Build: `cargo build -p sift --bin sift`
- Test all Sift targets: `cargo test -p sift`
- Format check: `cargo fmt --package sift -- --check`
- Run local durable Sift: `cargo run -p sift -- serve --role all --data-dir /var/lib/sift`
- Run local disposable Sift: `cargo run -p sift -- serve --role all --ephemeral`
- Render the CRD: `cargo run -p sift -- k8s crd render`
- Render an instance: `cargo run -p sift -- k8s instance render --profile dev`
- Print the API contract: `cargo run -p sift -- spec`

## Verification limits

Local tests do not prove a live GKE rollout, a live GCS recovery, a 24-hour
soak, or the stated production throughput and latency targets. Report those
items as unverified until their real gates run.
